title: Heroes & Comics
subtitle: Superhero films and broader comic-book adaptations.

sections.name: I. Marvel — MCU
sections.desc: Marvel Studios proper. Iron Man through current.

items.title: Iron Man
items.pitch: Tony Stark builds a powered exoskeleton to escape captivity, then rebrands as a high-tech vigilante. Foundational MCU — the moment the modern superhero machine got its tone.

critics.quote: Imaginative illustration of an epic story.

**A long form review originally posted in 2010:**

Marking the beginning of the latest Marvel franchise, _The Avengers_, is Jon Favreau's _Iron Man_.

I'm quite fond of Super Hero movies, I don't love them to the same extent that I do the slasher or psychological thriller genres, but they do hol

items.title: The Avengers
items.pitch: First major team-up of Iron Man, Cap, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye against Loki and a Chitauri invasion of New York. The crossover that proved the model would scale.

critics.quote:
With a movie like this you wonder how all of the otherwise, main characters will work together and support the story.

No problems here.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
items.pitch: Star-Lord, Gamora, Drax, Rocket, and Groot reluctantly team to save the universe — set to a 70s mixtape that became as iconic as the film.

critics.quote: This movie was so AWESOME! I loved it all and i had a bad day before watching it but it turned it around.
Really funny and with great spcial effects.

items.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
items.pitch: Steve Rogers vs. a brainwashed Bucky Barnes inside a 70s political-thriller skeleton dressed as superhero film. Series high point for many.

critics.quote: This is indeed a great piece of superhero entertainment.

Put *a little* bit of brain in a superhero's movie script and you will have everybody talking wonders about it.

This is not a bad movie but neither astonishing.

items.title: Doctor Strange
items.pitch: Arrogant neurosurgeon loses his hands, finds the Mystic Arts. Inception-style reality-folding visuals are the headline.

critics.quote: With each new Marvel film one could expect the studio to push the limits of what a superhero film should consist of.

All continues to be well in the Marvel Comics Universe as the film adaptation of another mischievous and majestic superhero from Stan Lee’s printed page empire emerges and reigns supreme on the big screen.

items.title: Black Panther
items.pitch: T'Challa returns home to Wakanda to claim the throne, faces Killmonger — a villain whose grievance is harder to dismiss than usual. Cultural moment, Best Picture nominee.

critics.quote: The reviews for _Black Panther_ are all essentially saying the same thing: This is a great movie because it's so different from anything we've seen before, not just in the MCU but in the superhero genre overall, the villain is fantastic and _Black Panther_ is just a new and totally innovative film.
This is definitely one of Marvel's best because the story is compelling and the characters are well developed.

items.title: Avengers: Infinity War
items.pitch: Thanos collects the Infinity Stones, the Avengers can't stop him, half of all life is wiped out. The cliffhanger that made the audience gasp.

critics.quote:
"It is a bold undertaking, to readjust what is expected of the MCU/Avengers formula, and there are moments when the sheer scale and momentum match the narrative ambition..."

Read the full review here: http://screen-space.squarespace.com/reviews/2018/4/25/avengers-infinity-war.html.
Amazing.  Visually stunning.

items.title: Avengers: Endgame
items.pitch: Time-heist conclusion to the Infinity Saga. Ten-year payoff for the team-up era.

critics.quote: The epic Marvel Saga that started over ten years ago has been building up to the inevitable clash with the powerful tyrant Thanos (Josh Brolin).

Hey, so, just some really quick thoughts I wanna get down, 'cause it's after 1 o'clock in the morning, and I wanna get some sleep so I can wake up well rested to see _Endgame_ again.

Putting it out there right from the get-go, _Avengers: Endgame_ is my favourite MCU movie.

sections.name: II. Marvel — Non-MCU
sections.desc: Fox X-Men/FF era, Sony Spider-Verse, Sony alt-Marvel, Spider-Man trilogies.

items.title: X-Men
items.pitch: Bryan Singer launches the modern superhero film. Mutants vs. Magneto's Brotherhood, Wolverine introduced to mainstream audiences.

items.title: X2: X-Men United
items.pitch: Sequel that elevates the X-Men trilogy — Stryker, Nightcrawler's White House attack opening, the Jean Grey sacrifice.

critics.quote: X2: X-Men United is an improvement over its predecessor in just about every way.
Strong sequel. I didn't quite enjoy 'X2' as much as 'X-Men', though not by much in truth.

items.title: Spider-Man
items.pitch: Sam Raimi's earnest, comic-book-coded Peter Parker origin. Defining Spider-Man performance for a generation.

critics.quote: Sam Raimi's Spider-Man captures the spirit of the comic book hero and it's still one of my all time favourite superhero movies.
So many Spiderman movies out there but this will always be the original.

items.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
items.pitch: Miles Morales meets every Spider-Person across the multiverse. Animation that broke open what the genre could look like.

critics.quote: First of all, I love the animation style in this film.
It's true I liked it less than perhaps the vast majority of _Spider-Verse's_ audience, but this was still great, the animation enamouring, and the depth of its story and reference totally engaging.

items.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
items.pitch: Spider-Verse Part 2. Even more ambitious art-direction — each universe rendered in its own visual language. Cliffhanger ending.

critics.quote:
Life as a teenager is never easy and when you are gifted with the superhuman abilities of a spider and lead a double life as a student and crime fighter; life gets even harder.

Miles Morales (Shameik Moore) is finding it even harder to hide his secret from his family who has grown concerned that

FULL SPOILER-FREE REVIEW @ https://www.firstshowing.net/2023/review-spider-man-across-the-spider-verse-is-an-animated-work-of-art/

"Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse is the epitome of incredibly detailed, gorgeously unique, undeniably epic animation within its medium.

items.title: Deadpool
items.pitch: Wade Wilson breaks the fourth wall, the rating, and the genre. The R-rated superhero film that proved there was an audience for it.

critics.quote:
A funny movie with a romantic love story.

Wade Wilson (Ryan Reynolds) is a former Special Forces operative who now works as a mercenary.

I actually enjoyed the movie so much that i'll recommend it to all my friends, at first i didn't really want to watch it because i'm not into super hero movies at all, but i did anyway, i mean people were talking so much about it i had to see it myself and what an awesome choice i made.

items.title: Logan
items.pitch: Western-coded Wolverine endgame. Aged Logan, Professor X with seizures, X-23 — the rare superhero film willing to be a real elegy.

critics.quote:
**LOGAN REVIEW: THE WOLVERINE GETS A SUPER SEND-OFF**

"Owing to its agitated hero’s misfortunes through the ages, this is a film that’s acutely aware of the dangers of emotional exploitation, and it spares its audience a similar fate.

One of the best and most mature Marvel movies to date.

The first half of this movie is a huge delight and a huge thrill.

sections.name: III. DC
sections.desc: DC Extended Universe, Snyderverse, current DCU, prior eras.

items.title: The Dark Knight
items.pitch: Heath Ledger's Joker vs. Bale's Batman in a post-9/11 crime epic that happens to wear a cowl. Genre-redefining performance.

critics.quote: Excellent movie. Best of the trilogy.
This has no competition. It is the very finest comic-book character movie ever made.

items.title: Joker
items.pitch: Phoenix's Arthur Fleck descends into the title character, Scorsese-by-way-of-Gotham. Best Actor win, polarizing reception.

critics.quote:
If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog :)

Obviously, Joker is one of my most anticipated movies of 2019.

Joker. The character that has existed since 1940, has become so heavy with so many different portrayals, different origins, that it feels impossible for any mortal man alive to impersonate the scattered personalities.

items.title: Wonder Woman
items.pitch: Diana of Themyscira enters WWI. The first DCEU film to land critically; Gadot anchors a sincere, optimistic origin.

critics.quote:
I'd just like to thank Patty Jenkins for making a DCIThoughtSheWasWithUniverse movie that wasn't fucking garbage.

If I'm being completely honest, the two people I went to the cinema to watch _Wonder Woman_ with and I did spend the next two hours after coming out of our screening discussing the va

**The First Great DCEU Film**

This film is the origin story of Diana Prince/Wonder Woman (Gal Gadot), who was first introduced in Batman v.

items.title: The Batman
items.pitch: Reeves's Year-Two Batman as detective. Pattinson's brooding Bruce, Riddler as Zodiac stand-in, Nirvana on the soundtrack.

critics.quote:
“The Batman” Is A Very Engaging And Unforgettable Tale That Is One Of The Best Adaptations Of The Character Ever

In 1989 Michael Keaton was seen as a very controversial choice to wear the Cowl of Batman but soon proved his doubters wrong by turning “Batman” and its subsequent sequel “Batman Retur
The reviews and hype for this movie were massive!  Comparisons to The Dark Knight got my expectations high...

items.title: Aquaman
items.pitch: Wan's underwater fantasy, full Saturday-morning operatic energy. Momoa as Arthur Curry, Patrick Wilson chewing scenery.

critics.quote:
***Lame-axx butt of a joke no longer*** 

Arthur Curry (Jason Momoa) lives with his father on the Maine Coast, a caretaker of a lighthouse.
I just came back home from watching Aquaman on the IMAX theater in Balexert in Geneva and thought that I should write something up while it’s still fresh in my mind.

items.title: The Suicide Squad
items.pitch: Gunn's R-rated reboot. Bloater, Polka-Dot Man, Ratcatcher 2 vs. Starro the Conqueror. The 2016 film disowned and replaced.

critics.quote:
The Suicide Squad...
...stayed true to the hype of the anti-hero teams in DC.

I feel like it wasn't really a sequel but rather a reboot and ignoring the first film.
The action was insane and BLOODY brilliant, with a stellar cast.
For sure has its moments and also has James Gunn's fingerprints with the dark humor.

items.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
items.pitch: Musical sequel to Joker. Phoenix and Lady Gaga in a folie-à-deux courtroom-and-Arkham two-hander built on jukebox standards. Polarizing.

critics.quote: Great title, great movie. I had heard tiny bits about 'Joker: Folie à Deux' falling below expectations since its release, though they weren't substantial enough to know if the film was any good or not.

**_Joker falls in love in prison and goes to trial while singing songs_**

sections.desc: Hellboy, Dredd, Kick-Ass, Image, Dark Horse, etc.

items.title: Watchmen
items.pitch: Snyder's faithful-to-a-fault adaptation of Moore/Gibbons. Doctor Manhattan on Mars, Rorschach's journal, the squid replaced by a blue alternate.

critics.quote:
The comic book geek blockbuster for adults only.

Watchmen is directed by Zack Snyder and adapted to screenplay by David Hayter and Alex Tse from the Alan Moore/David Gibbons graphic novel.

If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog :)

First of all, this review is based on the theatrical version of Watchmen.

items.title: V for Vendetta
items.pitch: Wachowski-scripted Alan Moore adaptation. Dystopian future Britain, masked anarchist V, Natalie Portman radicalized into action.

items.title: Kick-Ass
items.pitch: Mark Millar adaptation about a normal kid who decides to be a superhero. Hit-Girl's introduction is the cultural memory.

critics.quote: I thought this movie was a super comedy movie but I was wrong.
A blast! What a great near two hours this is! 'Kick-Ass' is a fantastic superhero movie, one that doesn't take itself seriously and that is actually the biggest compliment I can make.

items.title: Hellboy
items.pitch: Del Toro's Mike Mignola adaptation. Ron Perlman as the demon-with-a-day-job, Lovecraftian texture, hand-built creature work.

critics.quote: I love the Mike Mignola _Hellboy_ comics, and this movie is a pretty massive deviation from that source material.
Hellboy is not a movie for everyone, no matter how much humour is in the screenplay.

sections.name: V. Deconstructive
sections.desc: Watchmen, Joker, the genre interrogating itself.

sections.name: VI. Cosmic
sections.desc: Guardians of the Galaxy, Eternals, Captain Marvel, the space-tier of the genre.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
items.pitch: Gunn's Guardians sendoff. Rocket's origin, the High Evolutionary as a cruel god — darker and more felt than the prior two.

critics.quote: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 is the perfect farewell to this quirky group of rogues we never expected to love so much. Our faith in the Marvel Cinematic Universe waned throughout Phase 4 with films that felt hollow, rushed, and insincere.

**A heartfelt & entrancing closure to our favourite band of misfits from marvel **

GOTG Vol 3 is a fantastic, emotionally immersive product from Marvel which not only made me delighted with the experience but also revived my faith in Marvel Studios.

items.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
items.pitch: Wade and Logan brought into the MCU. Cameo-heavy multiverse romp, leans on audience nostalgia for Fox-era X-Men.

critics.quote: Its story may not be the strongest, but the comedy makes 'Deadpool & Wolverine' an excellent watch! There are some top notch gags in there, particularly to do with the recent offscreen changes for Wade Wilson's alter ego.
_Deadpool & Wolverine_ is the best the MCU has been since Guardians of the Galaxy Vol.

items.title: Thunderbolts*
items.pitch: MCU's anti-team — Yelena, Bucky, US Agent, Ghost, Red Guardian. Quieter, character-driven take after Phase 4 fatigue.

critics.quote: Directed by Jake Schreier (Netflix’s Beef, Showtime’s Kidding) and written by Eric Pearson (Transformers One, Black Widow) and Joanna Calo (The Bear, Bojack Horseman), Thunderbolts* documents the emptiness surrounding Yelena Belova (Florence Pugh) as she goes through the motions while working for th

Thunderbolts genuinely surprised me. I went in expecting a fun Marvel team up but got something even better: a fresh story, fantastic humor, and well-rounded characters that made it stand out in the MCU.

The Vault escape sequence was funny and memorable, capturing the chaotic spirit and humorous

items.title: Brightburn
items.pitch: What if Superman were evil? Horror-coded answer. Gunn-produced; brutal in places, deliberate concept.

critics.quote:
Bad Superman

What if superman was a bad guy? That's the premise Brightburn is built upon.
Greatful film with good special effects, interesting story and cool cast.

items.title: Glass
items.pitch: Eastrail 177 trilogy capper. Dunn, Mr. Glass, and Kevin's many personalities all in the same psychiatric hospital.

critics.quote: It is hard to believe it has been 19 years since “Unbreakable” arrived in cinemas as the film seemed to setup a sequel but it did not look like it would come to fruition.

If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog :)

You all know how anxious I was about this movie.

items.title: The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen
items.pitch: Alan Moore adaptation universally hated by Moore. Sean Connery's last film.

critics.quote: This movie was amazing! Went to see it at the cinema when it first got released back in 2003.
Enjoyed it. 'The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen' does nothing all that extraordinary but produces a fun time nevertheless.

items.title: The New Mutants
items.pitch: Fox X-Men spinoff buried by Disney transition. Horror-coded mutant teens.

critics.quote:
Surprisingly great watch, will likely watch again, and do recommend.

My expectations of this one were rock bottom: I honestly didn't think much of the trailer.

items.pitch: Singer's Apocalypse-era X-Men. Generally regarded as the weakest of the modern X-Men trilogy.

critics.quote: Not really a step forward in the X-Men franchise.
X-Men Apocalypse is typical of what you would expect from a Marvel X-Men movie.
